description: Stromleitungsnetz der Westfalen Weser Netz GmbH (WWN) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The supply network includes spatial data on the “Electricity” division, distribution network and transport network within the grid area. The data is kept up-to-date in a geographical information system and made available as a PDF file in case of legitimate interest. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Power line network of Westfalen Weser Netz GmbH (WWN)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Strom, Versorgungsbereich Niederspannung, Stromleitung, Beleuchtung, Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, Niederspannung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
